In [[homogenization (mathematics)|homogenization theory]], a branch of [[mathematics]], '''stochastic homogenization''' is a technique for understanding solutions to [[partial differential equations]] with [[oscillatory]] [[random variable|random]] coefficients.<ref>{{cite web |title=Stochastic Homogenization |url=https://www.mis.mpg.de/applan/research/homogenization.html |website=www.mis.mpg.de |accessdate=11 June 2018 |language=en}}</ref>
